causal_divergence: The first deferred-blanking implementation stores an absolute index into the current output Vec. try_include recursively calls process with a fresh output Vec and then extends its caller; a sprite opened in the included file can close in the caller, so the absolute opening index no longer identifies its span. This is source-traced, not a measured Java claim.
